definitions.explanation: steel bars used to reinforce concrete structures
short for {鉄筋|てっきん}コンクリート; used in real estate to describe building construction type

examples.japanese: {鉄筋|てっきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧。
{鉄筋|てっきん}⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄筋|てっきん}{造|づくり}だ。
examples.english: This apartment building is reinforced concrete construction.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron/steel) + {筋|きん} (bar, sinew)

CONSTRUCTION TYPES (in real estate listings):
- {鉄筋|てっきん}⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧ (reinforced concrete - RC)
- ⟦{鉄骨|てっこつ}→鉄骨：24552_tekkotsu⟧ (steel frame - S)
- {鉄骨鉄筋|てっこつてっきん}⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧ (steel-framed reinforced concrete - SRC)
- ⟦{木造|もくぞう}→木造：08328_mokuzou⟧ (wooden construction)

REAL ESTATE NOTE:
Building construction type affects rent, durability, soundproofing, and earthquake resistance. {鉄筋|てっきん} buildings are generally more expensive but offer better sound insulation.
